research_question: Do Bitcoin and gold exhibit sufficiently similar sensitivities to major macro-financial risks for the digital-gold analogy to be informative from an asset-allocation perspective?
temporal_contracts: Bitcoin is sampled at the exact NYSE Arca close for each GLD session.
No temporal fallback is permitted for missing exact-close Bitcoin observations in the frozen specification.
CPI state used for daily conditioning must be available by the preceding traditional-market close.
NFCI is never represented as point-in-time information.
publication_contracts: Primary-sample coverage must remain at or above 97 percent of valid asset-return observations.
Recent-only HY OAS data may not reduce the primary sample.
Publication-level stress windows must be non-overlapping.
The frozen publication state must pass the V4.1.1 validation layer.
Controlled publication artifacts must match the publication manifest.
non_claims: No causal identification of macro-factor effects.
No return forecast or predictive-power claim.
No universal statement for all Bitcoin venues or all gold instruments.
No inflation-surprise claim without a market-consensus series.
No external audit, regulatory certification or asset-manager endorsement.
